title: HelperFSInventoryResult
description: Result of the helper fs service's inventory op: every write-session temporary this helper could not remove. A helper that dies between write-open and the end of its session leaves a temporary beside a target; the journal is what lets a later generation name and remove it, and this op is what reports the ones it could not. `stranded` is never null — a clean host answers [] — because a decoder must not have to tell 'no leftovers' from 'no answer', and a panel that read null as 'cannot say' would report a clean host as an unknown one.

stranded.description: The temporary files that outlived their session and survived this helper's attempt to remove them. Never null.

One temporary file: where it is, and why removing it failed. The path is absolute and names the temporary itself, not the target it was written for; the reason is the refusal the operating system gave, because 'read-only file system' and 'operation not permitted' are different facts a person acts on differently.

path.description: The absolute path of the temporary that could not be removed.

reason.description: Why the removal failed, in the operating system's own words. Required so 'stranded' always says what would have to change.
